newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee down nearly 7 pct, cocoa edges up.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee down nearly 7 pct, cocoa edges up.

text.p: COFFEE - Extends sharp falls as fund sell-off continues. Sept fell by nearly 7.0 pct to a new low at $1,615. Off $105 at $1,630 by 1408 GMT. COCOA - Regains some strength after slight losses in morning. Sept up five stg at 1,038 stg a tonne. SUGAR - Mostly lower with activity shifts to October as Aug positions rolled forward ahead of Wednesday expiry. Oct down 40 cents at $316.50.
